questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Clonorchis sinensis?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
questions.explanation: Embryonated eggs in stool. Concentration and wet-mount microscopy around 400×.
